name: context-budget
description: Compact reminders as the context grows, a check before resuming a large session after the prompt cache expires, and per-type models with a minimum effort for subagents.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages. auto follows the language setting in settings.json: Chinese gets zh-TW, anything else gets en.

first_threshold.title: First reminder (tokens)
first_threshold.description: Context size that triggers the first compact reminder. On a 200k context window, set it below 200000.

threshold_step.title: Remind again every (tokens)
threshold_step.description: After the first reminder, remind again each time the context grows by this many tokens.

idle_minutes.title: Idle check (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Hold the first message sent after this many idle minutes, so you can compact before the expired prompt cache is written again.

idle_min_tokens.title: Idle check minimum (tokens)
idle_min_tokens.description: Skip the idle check when the context is smaller than this.

explore_model.title: Explore subagent model
explore_model.description: Model for Explore subagents spawned without a model. inherit leaves Claude Code's choice alone.

guide_model.title: claude-code-guide subagent model
guide_model.description: Model for claude-code-guide subagents spawned without a model. inherit leaves Claude Code's choice alone.

plan_model.title: Plan subagent model
plan_model.description: Model for Plan subagents spawned without a model. inherit leaves Claude Code's choice alone.

subagent_effort_floor.title: Minimum subagent effort
subagent_effort_floor.description: Subagents that would run below this effort level run at it instead. off turns the floor off.
